description: Leaf Bird default look, PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/leaf_bird-character-sheet.png (the sheet is titled 'LEAF FISH'; the artist corrected it to a BIRD). Chips (intake.json swatches): main body 56,191,33 / leaf markings 4,115,25 / fin highlight 121,190,91 / beak 200,133,30 / eye 254,248,220. A bright-green streamlined leaf body in a dive with dark-green leaf-vein markings (belly segment bands, the midrib line along the back and belly, the wing veins and the back crest's vein net), a thin light-green highlight streak along the top of the back, a pointed amber beak and round off-white eyes with an amber iris. The black ink outline is drawing style and is not a region. No glow (the sheet draws none): every region writes zero Glow.
